decisions.reason: As the multi-variant organic flagship anchoring the firm's publicly announced organic direction, it carries the heaviest strategic and reputational commitment, so management would treat any softness as ramp-up and persist.

The premium sharing salami line sits at the core salami competence, has several variants and a dedicated page, and the firm has already pruned its snack range with B, so further sunk investment and visibility argue for keeping it.

Freshly launched and publicly announced as a new member of the organic team, the organic Fleischwurst fits the stated organic expansion, so any early weak results would be attributed to the launch phase.
This multi-variant organic chicken line was publicly launched with its own page and extends the organic poultry direction after B's exit, making it a commitment management would defend.
The organic herb-coated salami was launched only in 2024, is close to the core, has its own page and fits the organic push, so it is too early and too committed to drop.
